sources.basis: AWS sections 4 and 5, one aggregated 8xB300 vLLM deployment, MXFP4 / FP8 KV. C1 mean TTFT for 1024 tokens and client mean ITL for 1024/1024 and 8000/1024. Use prompt plus half the generated length for mean decode context. Concurrency proxies scheduled batch. Endpoint timings include service overhead and ramp-up. There is no C1 longer-context measurement. Outside these points infer incremental dense MLA work from the pinned K3 geometry at HGX dense BF16 peak (36 sparse PF/s / 2 / 8) and DGX node HBM peak (62 TB/s / 8). These are sensitivity assumptions, not GPU step measurements.
